in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Fabiolas is derived from the Hebrew words 'fabi' (exalted) and 'yolah' (war). This name means 'exalted or prosperous in war'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to a person named Fabiolas.

in_greek.name: Φαβιολά
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Fabiolas is derived from the Greek word 'pheboulos' (warlike). This name means 'warlike'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to a person named Fabiolas.

in_latin.name: Fabiola
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Fabiola is derived from the Latin words 'fabius' (warlike) and 'ola' (little). This name means 'little warlike one'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to a person named Fabiolas. However, there is a popular saint by this name.
